svg.title: NOI Pipeline
svg.text: Kärnten · Linz AG · ÖBB · OÖVV · Stmk · SVV · VOR · VVT · VVV

a.text: drops STA's re-import of VVT Reschen
every RAP feed → IT:<NUTS-2>: id space
--home IT:ITALO — the vote cannot reach it
per region · union operators · qualify colliding ids
--no-consolidate-stops · the stop merge runs once, nationally
then fix/BindQuaylessAssignments — the survivor still names no quay
union of the RAPs + rail + STA · --synthesize-stops
StopPlace + Quay + PSA per unassigned SSP — ids settle only after qualification
GTT's extra link at the terminus
rejoin ÖBB halves split across two Lines

svg.text: EPIP conversion — one consolidation over every feed, one conversion per shard

a.text: conv/FeedsToConsolidatedDbToDb — merge at · ch · it · flix and consolidate their stations, --split at,ch,it,flix
cross-border scan — rail StopPlace consolidation (~440 m; strict rail mode, same-namespace + 2×-diameter guards), strict bus quay merge
(2+2 poles · 100 m mutual-nearest · public-code agreement) — it cannot be sharded, a border station's
copies come from different countries; clone + overlay per feed with a cumulative key offset, then resolve()
conv/EpipDbToDb ×4 — one per consolidated feed, concurrent under make -j (four write txns, not one)
A1 / A2 — de-embed ServiceCalendar children · PassengerStopAssignment StopPlaceRef backfill
B — six generators in order: sanitize · calendar · interchange · lines · locations · journeys
C — repair interchange points, then one streaming ensemble pass: WGS84 reprojection ·
ServiceJourneyPattern direction inference · operator / vehicleType / quay-name backfills
C2 — strip orphan LevelRefs (a LevelRef whose Level its own Site does not define)
D — day-offset rewrite: 24:20:00 → 00:20:00 + <DepartureDayOffset>1</>, enabled here via
conv/MergeDbToDb — the four converted shards back into one store: raw keep-first clone (first source
wins on a duplicate id), referrers of dropped rows re-inserted, then resolve() + resolveEmbeddings()
runs AFTER the EPIP conversion — gated on one journey shape (passing times, no <Calls>) and on the day-offset rewrite
read calendars + stations · scan journeys · alias split stations (rail 1,500 m, road ~1 km) · stitch continuations · group · tile
cut legs at the border · one stay-seated ServiceJourneyInterchange per junction · one Quay per handover · validate point refs
drop redundant publications + the TrainNumbers they orphan · a dropped journey takes its JourneyMeetings · re-run EPIP phase C
split EPIP export — 8 shards: shared-01…06 frames · g<n>-shared per shard · g<n>-<k> journey groups
each group self-contained — its patterns' ServiceLinks and its journeys' interchanges ride with it
